# Michelle Galoob — Intuitive Consultant

> Michelle Galoob is a channel, intuitive guide, coach and spiritual mentor, and an Akashic Records reader. She offers one-on-one Akashic Records readings by phone, and teaches people to recognize, trust and follow their own intuition through a free Intuition Activation Starter Kit and the Intuition Mastery Program. Certified through the James Van Praagh School of Mystical Arts (JVP Mediumship Level I Certification Course; Certified Psychic Intuitive Messenger).

Key facts:
- Readings (by phone): 30 min ($200), 45 min ($285), 1 hour ($375), package of 2 one-hour sessions ($660), package of 4 one-hour sessions ($1,280).
- Who readings help: people who feel blocked, are at a crossroads, want to connect with their soul's purpose, or have questions about personal or business relationships.
- Free Intuition Activation Starter Kit: 7-minute video on getting answers from your spirit guides; The Intuition Reality Check (6 ways to know your intuition is real); decision-making tool (coming soon); priority waitlist for an advanced masterclass.
- Intuition Mastery Program: on-demand self-paced workshop (lifetime access), live 3-hour workshop, and 12 months of mentorship — monthly live practice sessions, group readings, masterclasses, resource library, guest-expert events; all sessions recorded.
- Program price: $1,197 (listed total value $2,101). VIP Private Executive Coaching: $4,997 (6 months, 2 private sessions/month, by application).
- Guarantee: 14-day Inner Knowing Guarantee (full refund on request).  [TO CONFIRM: some promo pages say 7 days]
- Experience: trained for 10 months in the Akashic Records with a renowned healer from Argentina; approach is grounded and practical ("No airy fairy here!").  [TO CONFIRM: training site says "15+ years"; About story says "about 13 years ago"]
- Testimonials include Carole Crist (Former First Lady of Florida), Ken Fried (Founder, Opendoor Venture Capital), Jesse Osher (Founder, Jesse's Wakeup Bar).
- Contact: +1 424-777-3672 · michellegaloob@gmail.com · Instagram @michellegaloob
